subject: GeoSource verification and wipe procedure request
messages:
From: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@maplebank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: MapleBank Legal <legal@maplebank.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated instance — confirmation of data locality and deletion steps

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team needs a short written confirmation of how Redwood will ensure all MapleBank tenant data for our Dedicated deployment is pinned to the US-west region (no replica outside the region) and the exact wipe steps you will execute at decommission time.

Specifically we need:
- Confirmation that primary compute, disk, and backup snapshots are region-bound for tenant MPB-4821.
- Whether any cross-region asynchronous backups or replication exist by default.
- The expected timeline and artifacts for a full tenant wipe (including snapshot purges and log retention trim).

Can you send a one-page runbook and any compliance artifacts you can share? Legal would like to review before our procurement sign-off.

Best,
Sara Jensen
Head of Cloud Security, MapleBank

[Attachment: maplebank_soc2_summary.docx (docx)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@maplebank.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated instance — confirmation of data locality and deletion steps

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. Quick clarifying Qs so we send exactly what Legal needs:

1) When you say "pin to US-west": do you require a hard policy that prohibits any cross-region failover, or is acceptable a controlled failover plan that is exercised only under disaster and requires pre-approved authorization?
2) Do you need evidence for ephemeral in-memory KV caches being scrubbed (we invalidate KV caches on session end, but can provide trace logs) or only disk/snapshot artifacts?
3) For snapshot retention: do you want immediate purge on decommission or a short hold window (e.g., 7 days) for recovery?

I can attach a short ops runbook draft and a one-page summary of our encryption and snapshot purge flow. If Legal prefers, I’ll include the exact file names and hash of deleted snapshots as the artifact.

I’ll loop in our ops and compliance leads once I have your preferences.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cell: +1 415-555-0149

From: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@maplebank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: MapleBank Legal <legal@maplebank.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated instance — confirmation of data locality and deletion steps

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the quick reply.

Answers: 1) We require no automatic cross-region failover for routine maintenance; disaster failover is allowed but must be documented and require pre-approval from MapleBank operations.
2) Disk/snapshot evidence is our primary ask; KV cache scrubs are nice-to-have but not mandatory.
3) Immediate purge on tenant offboarding is preferred; if impossible we will accept a maximum 72-hour hold with an explicit documented reason.

I’m attaching our SOC summary and the procurement checklist. Legal will expect the runbook to show snapshot removal, backup deletion, and a final verification artifact (sha256 of deleted snapshot manifests or similar).

Appreciate it —
Sara

[Attachment: procurement_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated instance — confirmation of data locality and deletion steps

Team — draft checklist below (will attach full script + dry-run logs):

Checklist (Draft)
- Verify tenant placement: run "redwoodctl tenant inspect MPB-4821 --region" -> expect "us-west-2" and "replication: none"
- Quiesce inbound requests and notify customer via email (ops ticket)
- Create final snapshot manifest: list snapshots "redwoodctl snapshot list --tenant MPB-4821 --final"
- Delete snapshots: "redwoodctl snapshot delete --id <snapshot-id> --force" (parallelized)
- Purge backup buckets: confirm S3 buckets tagged mpb-4821 are deleted/emptied (run s3 lifecycle check)
- Verify no cross-region objects exist: run object-inventory filter by region
- Generate verification artifacts: snapshot-manifest.csv, sha256sums.txt, audit-log-extract.json (store hashes and provide checksum)
- Post-wipe audit: run retention-trim for logs older than 30 days; export audit summary to PDF

Open Q: we currently keep continuous incremental snapshots for 24 hrs for warm recovery. For an immediate purge requirement we can force-delete but need operator approval to proceed. That would meet the 72-hour SLA; immediate purge is operationally doable with the operator pre-authorization.

I’ll attach the script and a sample sha256 list.

—Ben
Principal DevOps Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-06T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated instance — confirmation of data locality and deletion steps

Thanks — I reviewed Ben’s checklist and added the approvals and timeline language below for Legal:

1) Data locality statement: "Redwood will bind tenant MPB-4821 to the us-west region. No automated cross-region replication will be configured for this tenant. In the event of disaster failover, cross-region actions require pre-approved change control and will be executed only after MapleBank operations signs off."

2) Wipe timeline & artifacts: 
- Standard decommission flow: operator executes snapshot purge and bucket removal; artifacts (snapshot-manifest.csv and sha256sums.txt) generated within the same business day.
- If immediate purge is requested, operator will execute force-delete; artifacts produced and delivered within 72 hours.

3) Evidence: we will provide snapshot manifests, sha256 checksums, and an audit-log extract listing the deletion events. We can also provide signed hash of the archive if Legal requires.

I attached the one-page runbook (requested_ops_runbook_template.pdf) and a short CSV sample (slice-one-snapshot-matrix.csv) that shows the manifest format. Once Kimberly approves wording, we should send to MapleBank + Legal.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
